name: openrct2-switch
title: OpenRCT2
author: OpenRCT2
description: An open source theme-park management game.
details:
OpenRCT2 is a open source reimplementation of the RollerCoaster Tycoon series. 
It requires your own game files placed in sdmc:/switch/openrct2/
This port supports various features including High-Res, Mouse mode, and more!.
